proactive_runs_owner_update.withCheck: tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND owner_user_id = tenant_id

proactive_runs_actor.name: proactive_runs_actor
proactive_runs_actor.value: ("proactive_runs"."source" = 'run_now' AND "proactive_runs"."actor_user_id" = "proactive_runs"."owner_user_id" AND "proactive_runs"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("proactive_runs"."source" IN ('schedule', 'legacy') AND "proactive_runs"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)

proactive_runs_lease.name: proactive_runs_lease
proactive_runs_lease.value: ("proactive_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "proactive_runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proactive_runs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "proactive_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proactive_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("proactive_runs"."status" <> 'running' AND "proactive_runs"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "proactive_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

proactive_runs_finished.name: proactive_runs_finished
proactive_runs_finished.value: ("proactive_runs"."status" IN ('queued', 'running') AND "proactive_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("proactive_runs"."status" NOT IN ('queued', 'running') AND "proactive_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

proactive_runs_result.name: proactive_runs_result
proactive_runs_result.value: "proactive_runs"."result" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("proactive_runs"."result") = 'object' AND "proactive_runs"."result" ?& ARRAY['readCount','suggestionCount'] AND "proactive_runs"."result" - ARRAY['readCount','suggestionCount'] = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof("proactive_runs"."result"->'readCount') = 'number' AND jsonb_typeof("proactive_runs"."result"->'suggestionCount') = 'number' AND ("proactive_runs"."result"->>'readCount')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 200 AND ("proactive_runs"."result"->>'readCount')::numeric = trunc(("proactive_runs"."result"->>'readCount')::numeric) AND ("proactive_runs"."result"->>'suggestionCount')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND ("proactive_runs"."result"->>'suggestionCount')::numeric = trunc(("proactive_runs"."result"->>'suggestionCount')::numeric))
